text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other's ideas and techniques. In addition, regular reviews help maintain a high level of team quality, since everyone follows the same standards and good practices. Although code reviews may take extra effort, they are worth it. They improve communication, reduce mistakes, and make the final product more reliable. In short, code reviews benefit both the team and the software itself.
